name: npr-test_goo_shader_info_smoke
purpose: Verify that the Shader Info node is registered with the expected input and output socket shape.
passCriteria: ShaderNodeShaderInfo exists and has the label Shader Info. Input sockets are World Position, Normal, and Exponent. Output sockets are Diffuse Shading, Shadow, Ambient Lighting, Half-Lambert Factor, Blinn-Phong Factor, Self Shadow, and Cast Shadow.
